title: DDE WebAPI profile
description: Marked by a resource typed schema:WebAPI that carries one of this profile's DDE resource type codes (service, webAPI, repository). The resource is the node with a catalog record (schema:subjectOf), so the members of a collection, which carry resource types of their own, do not count. Requires what the schema composes unconditionally. Not in an exclusiveGroup: a record with two resource types declares every profile it fits. DRAFT, generated from schema.yaml; not reviewed.
presence:
ASK {
  ?d schema:subjectOf ?record ; schema:additionalType ?type .
  ?d a schema:WebAPI .
  ?type schema:inDefinedTermSet ?set ; schema:termCode ?code .
  FILTER(STR(?set) IN ("dde:codelist/ResourceTypeCode", "https://www.ddeworld.org/resource/codelist/ResourceTypeCode"))
  FILTER(STR(?code) IN ("service", "webAPI", "repository"))
}
